evidence_quotes.O: Then, you get to learn how the Linux environment works, read the forums on how to speed things up or fix things
evidence_quotes.C: I, like most folks, like to test things out to see if they work before I invest much time in installation.
evidence_quotes.E: This is essential for me because my employees, who will not have the instruction manual available, will also be using the machine.
evidence_quotes.A: But my road to satisfaction had a bump I can help you avoid.
evidence_quotes.N: I am enduring a home remodel and bought my first APC UPS (an ES 550VA) to protect against tripped breakers and electrical interference
